# Mindbody

Mindbody provides scheduling, client management, commerce, and business operations software for fitness, wellness, and beauty businesses.

Category: Productivity. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/mindbody/.

## Actions

- **List Accessible Sites** (read-only): List Mindbody sites accessible to the connected API key, or retrieve fuller details by filtering to one site ID.
- **List Active Session Times** (read-only): List configured business-hour time slots and booking increments.
- **List Classes** (read-only): Search scheduled class instances by date, location, program, session type, instructor, or known class IDs.
- **List Enrollments** (read-only): Search scheduled multi-session enrollments such as workshops and events by date and business resource IDs.
- **List Locations** (read-only): List physical or online locations configured for the connected Mindbody site.
- **List Session Types** (read-only): List service and session types configured at the connected Mindbody site, including IDs used by schedule and availability searches.
- **List Staff** (read-only): List basic staff directory records available to the connected API key, with optional role, activity, and ID filters.
- **Search Products** (read-only): Search the connected site's read-only retail product catalog by text, IDs, categories, location, or online-sale status.
